context_requirements: Functional Hedgehog signaling pathway with expression of SMO, PTCH1, and GLI transcription factors
Presence of GLI1 or GLI2 amplification or overexpression for strong response
Ligand-independent activation of the pathway (e.g., PTCH1 loss or SMO mutation) may be required for robust transcriptional output
Intact primary cilia for canonical Hedgehog signaling
falsifiers: No significant change in GLI2 or PTCH1 expression at 6 h or 24 h in any cell line
Lack of dose-dependent modulation of Hedgehog target genes (e.g., GLI2, CCND1) across cell lines
No correlation between baseline Hedgehog pathway activity (e.g., GLI1 expression) and transcriptional response
Absence of any transcriptional response in cell lines known to have activated Hedgehog signaling (e.g., HT29, PC3)
